question: Do you supply cleanroom consumables?
html:
Cleanroom consumables

Cleanroom is a specialty area we are building toward. The information available here does not include our current product catalog, so we can't confirm which cleanroom consumables we stock today. For specific items, send your list to our inside sales team for an availability check and quote.

What we can confirm

  • Cleanroom is named as a specialty vertical in our growth plan, alongside cannabis testing, cold chain and forensics (Thomas Scientific growth plan, Oct 6, 2026).
  • The plan's three-year roadmap includes a possible West Coast cleanroom or life-science tuck-in by month 36. That would take us from 9 to 11 distribution centers. The plan calls this an assumption, not a forecast (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
  • The plan pairs specialty verticals with punchout ordering, vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and private label (Thomas Scientific growth plan).

What we can't confirm yet

These data would answer the question properly:

QuestionData that would answer it
Which cleanroom items do we carry?Current SKU list by category, with stock status by distribution center
How big is cleanroom for us today?Trailing 12-month sales and gross margin for cleanroom categories
Which customers need it?Tags on the 27,503 scored lab, pathology and hospital sites that flag cleanroom use
Can we serve it on the West Coast?Lead times and fill rates for western customers

None of these figures are in the material available here. We won't guess at range, pricing or lead times.

Getting an answer today

  • Send part numbers or descriptions to your account rep or inside sales.
  • Note the volumes and delivery locations you need.
  • Ask whether VMI or punchout ordering fits your setup.

Cleanroom is one of the specialty lines the plan counts on to shift mix toward an est. ~12% EBITDA margin by month 36. A clear catalog answer is an early test of whether that vertical is real before any tuck-in is considered (Thomas Scientific growth plan).

Next actions for the operating team

  1. Pull the cleanroom SKU list and trailing 12-month category sales and margin from the ERP. Confirm whether "yes, we supply it" is accurate.
  2. Tag likely cleanroom users among the 27,503 scored sites. Measure the overlap with the 713 Pursue and 2,317 Nurture sites (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
  3. If the range holds up, publish a cleanroom category page with punchout ordering. If it doesn't, list the gaps for private-label or supplier sourcing.
  4. Keep any West Coast cleanroom tuck-in at desk-screening stage. The plan rules out acquisitions while the refinancing of the loan maturing Dec 14, 2027 is open (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
